title: owo-lib issue #475: [NeoForge 1.21.1] owo crash when another mod opens a DLWindow-based client UI (Pantographs & Wires repro)
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by leafycanopy]
Environment
- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- Loader: NeoForge 21.1.224
- Accessories: 1.1.0-beta.53+1.21.1
- owo-lib: 0.12.15.5-beta.1+1.21
- Repro mod opening the screen: Create: Pantographs & Wires 1.21.1-alpha-0.2.0-1-C6+2
- Repro library in stack: DragonLib 1.21.1-beta-3.0.24
- Java: 21.0.8
- OS: Windows 11

Summary
I am reporting this here because the crash disappears when owo is removed, and my reduced-pack testing points to the Accessories/owo side being required for the failure.

A Pantographs & Wires client UI crashes on open with:
NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "io.wispforest.owo.util.pond.OwoScreenHandlerExtension.owo$attachToPlayer(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player)" because the return value of "net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.MenuAccess.getMenu()" is null

Repro
1. Start NeoForge 1.21.1
2. Have Accessories + owo installed
3. Use Create: Pantographs & Wires
4. Open either:
   - cantilever style/settings UI, or
   - wire type selection UI from the wire coil
5. Client crashes on screen init

Observed behavior
The crash occurs inside owo screen initialization when the screen appears to implement MenuAccess but returns null for getMenu().

Relevant stack frames
- io.wispforest.owo.client.screens.ScreenInternals$Client.lambda$init$0(ScreenInternals.java:86)
- net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen.init(...)
- net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.setScreen(...)
- de.mrjulsen.mcdragonlib.client.gui.widgets.base.DLWindow.openWindow(...)
- de.mrjulsen.paw.event.ClientWrapper.showCantileverSettingsScreen(...)
or
- de.mrjulsen.paw.event.ClientWrapper.showWireTypeSelectionScreen(...)

What I already ruled out
- This is not just a huge-pack conflict.
- The issue persists in a heavily sanitized environment.
- Removing owo makes the Pantographs/Wires UI work again.

Question
Is this a known NeoForge 1.21.1 owo/Accessories screen-hook issue when another mod opens a client-only window without a valid menu, or should I treat this entirely as a Pantographs/DragonLib-side bug?

[comment by Dragon-Seeker (member)]
1. This seems more of an issue with owolib and the DragonLib mod
2. It seems that the DragonLib is reimplementing `AbstractContainerScreen` by adding the `MenuAccess` class for screens that seemingly have no intention of ever having a menu, leading to owolib seeing a screen with `MenuAccess` and not expecting the null menu that does not happen within vanilla, as owolib has features to extend all container screens.

This should be reported to DragonLib to fix on their side.

[comment by dudebehinddude (none)]
It looks like this was fixed by dragonlib, should this issue be closed?
